🏀 BASKETBALL MANAGER '27 🏀
Take charge of an Basketball team and build a dynasty!

⭐ 30 Basketball teams with rosters and ratings
🏆 Play 24-game seasons, then fight through the play-in, best-of-7 playoffs and the Finals
🔁 Make trades with smart AI general managers
✍️ Negotiate contracts and sign real free agents all year
📈 Train your players and watch their ratings rise
🏅 Chase MVP, Rookie of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year
💰 Run your team's finances and keep the board happy
🎮 Watch live matches in a 3D arena and make subs mid-game
📱 Plays great on phone, tablet and PC

Be the coach, the GM and the owner. Rebuild a struggling team or take a contender all the way. How long can you stay on top?

👥 Join Serdios Games for $10M in every career!
🎁 Codes: RELEASE

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for new updates!
